case_title: TYRONE PERKINS VS. RUTH D RIZO LIZANO et al

docket_entries.description: DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT JUAREZ, CARMELITA

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-02-2014 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO JUL-28-2014 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. DEFENDANT'S BROTHER MARDOQUEO JUAREZ ASKED FOR A CONTINUANCE AS DEFENDANT CARMELITA JUAREZ IS OUT OF THE COUNTRY ON A FAMILY EMERGENCY AND THERE IS NO POS ON 2ND DEFENDANT RUTH LIZANO. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS (2) WERE NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT CARMELITA JUAREZ WAS REPRESENTED BY HER BROTHER MARDOQUEO JUAREZ. PLAINTIFF WILL DISMISS DEFENDANT RUTH LIZANO EITHER BEFORE THE HEARING OR AT THE NEXT HEARING DATE IN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

"THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NAMED PLAINTIFF IS NOT THE OWNER OF THIS VEHICLE", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT RUTH LIZANO. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT EXCEPT DEFENDANT RUTH LIZANO WHO WAS NOT PRESENT AT TODAYS HEARING. DEFENDANT WAS ASSISTED BY SPANISH INTERPRETER---MARDOQUEZ JUAREZ. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
